instruction: A candid outdoor photograph shows a full shot of an older couple walking together in a sunny grassy park. On the left, the older bearded man in a beige polo shirt and brown pants (R1) walks forward, carrying a rolled-up black yoga mat under his arm and holding a water bottle. Beside him on the right, the older woman in a white t-shirt and beige pants (R2) walks in stride, smiling as she raises a clear water bottle in her hand. They walk side-by-side under bright, natural daylight with lush green trees in the background.
